# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **Replies keep arriving after Reconnect:** Choosing **Retry** or **Reconnect** could leave every new message on "Thinking…" until Controller was quit. The agent kept working, but its replies, its requests to Controller and its progress never reached the chat, on the Mac or on your iPhone. Reconnecting now keeps them coming. - **Dictation cleanup you can watch:** When Apple Intelligence tidies a dictated message, the words it removes or changes dissolve into smoke and the corrected words form out of it, while the words it kept glide to their new places. This works on the Mac and on iPhone. With Reduce Motion on, it's a short crossfade. - **Steadier dictation waveform:** The waveform scrolls at an even pace instead of pausing and jumping ahead when the app is busy. - **Smoother animations on iPhone:** On ProMotion iPhones, Controller's own animations now run at up to 120 Hz, including the model and effort cards, the activity card, the dictation waveform and the jump-to-latest button. Before, they were held to 60 Hz. Opening the effort, context and activity cards no longer rebuilds them on every frame.

# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **Updates on their own:** Controller looks for a new version every 15 minutes and downloads it in the background. When one is ready, choose **Install Controller *version* and Restart** from the Controller menu, or it installs the next time you quit. - **Update a Mac from your iPhone or another Mac:** A Mac's details on iPhone and iPad, and **Settings → Connect → Your Macs** on another Mac, show its version and an **Update and Restart** button when an update is ready. Chats that are working stop before the update installs and pick up where they left off once Controller restarts, and your devices reconnect on their own. This works from the next update onwards, once each Mac runs this version. - **Faster start on a slow connection:** Your iPhone opens straight to the chats, projects and models it saved last time and connects to the Mac in the background, instead of waiting for the account check and the connection first. - **Keep working while it reconnects:** While your iPhone is still connecting or verifying the Mac, you can send messages, start a chat, change the model or its settings, and pin or settle chats; each goes to the Mac as soon as it's reached. - **Quicker to connect:** Connecting to a Mac takes fewer round trips, which is most noticeable on a slow or distant connection. Both the Mac and the device need this version. - **Steadier on changing networks:** When your iPhone switches between Wi-Fi and cellular or gets its signal back, it reconnects right away instead of waiting up to a minute. A message sent just as the connection dropped goes through once it's back, without being sent twice. Returning to Controller within 20 seconds of switching apps finds the Mac still connected. - **Large chats load on slow connections:** Opening a long chat, loading older messages or viewing pictures no longer times out on a slow link, and background loading of recent chats pauses in Low Data Mode and while you open a chat. - **Pictures in replies hold their place:** An inline picture keeps the same space while it loads, fails or is retried, so the chat no longer jumps.

# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **New connection service for remote access:** Making this Mac reachable from your other devices now uses OpenTunnel instead of a Cloudflare tunnel. There is no helper to download, and the Mac handles the secure connection itself, so the relay only carries encrypted traffic. The first time you turn it on, the Mac requests a certificate, which takes about a minute. Update each Mac you host from; until it updates, your other devices won't see it. - **Smoother streaming replies:** Replies appear a whole word at a time and new text fades in, instead of showing half-finished words and raw formatting marks while an agent writes. - **Answer tool requests from anywhere:** When a tool asks for permission, Decline and Cancel now work from your iPhone as well as the Mac. - **Screenshots in replies open reliably:** Images an agent links to by a screenshot's file name now open even when the name was typed with an ordinary space before AM or PM. - **Faster remote chats:** When viewing another Mac, the chat list and pictures in replies are saved on this device, so they appear at once when you reconnect or revisit a conversation.
